enable_fact_check.hint: Supports quoted text, inline claims, and quoted/inline images on OneBot/AstrBot message chains.

fact_check_access_control_fail_open.description: Allow fact-checking if the access-control plugin cannot be loaded
fact_check_access_control_fail_open.hint: Keep disabled so an ACL failure cannot expose an API-consuming command to every group.

fact_check_default_allow_private.description: Allow private fact-check requests when no explicit ACL rule matches

gemini_api_key.hint: Leave empty to use GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

fact_check_pre_model.description: Pre-processing model for extracting checkable claims

fact_check_evidence_model.hint: This model performs Google Search grounding and returns a complete fallback fact-check result.

fact_check_evidence_max_output_tokens.description: Output-token limit for the first grounded Gemini evidence result
fact_check_evidence_max_output_tokens.hint: Incomplete grounded evidence is retried once with the larger retry limit and is never sent as a fallback.

fact_check_evidence_retry_max_output_tok.description: Output-token limit for one retry after incomplete grounded evidence

fact_check_verdict_models.hint: These models receive the grounded evidence package without native Google Search. If they are unavailable, the grounded evidence result is sent directly.

fact_check_model_failure_cooldown_second.description: Seconds to skip an unavailable model after a 429 or 503 capacity failure
fact_check_model_failure_cooldown_second.hint: Prevents an overloaded verdict model from delaying each fact-check before its grounded fallback is sent.

fact_check_verdict_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout seconds for the Gemini 3 evidence-only verdict review
fact_check_verdict_timeout_seconds.hint: On timeout or two incomplete replies, the plugin sends the complete Gemini 2.5 grounded result.

fact_check_verdict_max_output_tokens.description: Output-token limit for the first Gemini 3 verdict review
fact_check_verdict_max_output_tokens.hint: A truncated verdict is retried once with the larger retry limit before falling back to grounded evidence.

fact_check_verdict_retry_max_output_toke.description: Output-token limit for one retry after a truncated Gemini 3 verdict

fact_check_verdict_policy.description: When to run the Gemini 3 evidence-only verdict review
fact_check_verdict_policy.hint: risk_based reviews multi-claim or sensitive topics; always reviews every result; never sends grounded evidence directly.

fact_check_verdict_thinking_level.description: Gemini 3 thinking level for the verdict review

fact_check_max_images.description: Max images to inspect per fact-check request

fact_check_max_image_bytes.description: Max bytes per image before it is split into compressed chunks

fact_check_image_download_hard_limit_byt.description: Hard download-size limit for one source image
fact_check_image_download_hard_limit_byt.hint: Images above this limit are rejected before decoding to protect memory.

fact_check_image_max_pixels.description: Maximum decoded pixel count for one source image
fact_check_image_max_pixels.hint: Rejects decompression-bomb style images before full decoding.

fact_check_image_total_inline_bytes.description: Maximum total base64 image payload bytes attached to one Gemini request

fact_check_image_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Maximum age of staged input images before cleanup

fact_check_image_cache_max_bytes.description: Maximum disk bytes retained by the staged input-image cache

fact_check_image_cache_max_files.description: Maximum file count retained by the staged input-image cache

fact_check_long_image_chunk_height.description: Chunk height used when an oversized long image is split

fact_check_long_image_max_parts.description: Max image chunks generated from one oversized long image

fact_check_long_image_max_width.description: Max width for oversized long-image chunks

fact_check_total_timeout_seconds.description: Total timeout seconds for one fact-check request
fact_check_total_timeout_seconds.hint: Prevents image extraction or Gemini grounding from making the QQ command look unresponsive.

fact_check_max_concurrent.hint: Keep this low to avoid Gemini rate-limit bursts.

fact_check_max_queue.description: Max queued/running fact-check jobs before rejecting new requests

fact_check_metrics_log_every.description: Log one aggregate performance summary after this many completed requests
fact_check_metrics_log_every.hint: Metrics contain counts and timings only, never request text or image references.

fact_check_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds to reuse the same fact-check reply for identical input

fact_check_followup_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds to keep a fact-check result available for reply follow-ups

fact_check_session_store_enabled.description: Persist follow-up sessions across plugin restarts
fact_check_session_store_enabled.hint: Stores reply text, checked claims, source links, and group/user ids in the plugin data directory with owner-only file permissions.

fact_check_followup_max_output_tokens.description: Output-token limit for the first grounded follow-up response

fact_check_followup_retry_max_output_tok.description: Output-token limit for one incomplete follow-up retry

fact_check_image_download_timeout_second.description: Timeout seconds for downloading each QQ image

fact_check_forward_max_fetch.description: Max merged-forward payloads to expand from a quoted/direct QQ chat-record card
fact_check_forward_max_fetch.hint: Includes nested forward ids. Keep small so one deep chat record cannot stall the command.

fact_check_pre_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout seconds for claim extraction requests

fact_check_main_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout seconds for the main grounded fact-check request

fact_check_anysearch_enabled.description: Enable Anysearch pre-retrieval evidence before the final Gemini fact-check
fact_check_anysearch_enabled.hint: When enabled, extracted claims are sent to Anysearch for search snippets and optional public-page extraction. This supplements but does not replace Gemini Google Search grounding.

fact_check_anysearch_api_key.hint: Optional. Leave empty to use anonymous Anysearch access or ANYSEARCH_API_KEY environment variable.

fact_check_anysearch_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout seconds for each Anysearch search/extract call

fact_check_anysearch_max_claims.description: Max extracted claims to search with Anysearch

fact_check_anysearch_max_results_per_cla.description: Max Anysearch search results per claim

fact_check_anysearch_extract_top_urls.description: How many top public result URLs to extract into cleaned plain-text evidence

fact_check_anysearch_max_chars.description: Max characters of Anysearch evidence inserted into the final fact-check prompt

fact_check_anysearch_freshness.description: Optional Anysearch freshness filter: day, week, month, or year

fact_check_anysearch_content_types.hint: Supported values include web, news, doc, academic, and data.

fact_check_show_failure_reason.description: Reply with a short reason when fact-checking fails

fact_check_debug_store_full_failure_text.description: Store full failed forward text for local debugging
fact_check_debug_store_full_failure_text.hint: Keep disabled to avoid persisting potentially sensitive chat content.
